war-horde.name: War Horde
war-horde._rule_note: This rule is named 'Get Stuck In', the same name as the Combat Patrol stratagem in data/stratagems.json. They are different content in different files and never collide, but do not merge them.
war-horde.ruleDescription: Get Stuck In: Melee weapons equipped by ORKS models from your army have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.
war-horde._grants_note: This rule grants a WEAPON ability rather than a unit ability, so it uses grantsWeaponAbilities. Matched units show it as a dashed badge on the relevant weapon rows.

da-big-hunt.name: Da Big Hunt
da-big-hunt._unique_note: No unique/exclusivity group was stated for this detachment, so it is left null like War Horde. Set it if one turns out to apply.
da-big-hunt._grants_note: Da Hunt Is On is STATEFUL: every benefit is conditional on the Prey unit you nominate each Command phase. There is nothing unconditional to hand out, so this detachment deliberately has no `grants` / `grantsWeaponAbilities` and puts no badges on unit cards. Read the rule from the scroll icon in the header. Do not invent a grant to make it look busier.
da-big-hunt.ruleDescription:
Da Hunt Is On: At the start of your Command phase, select one MONSTER, VEHICLE or CHARACTER unit from your opponent’s army. Until the start of your next Command phase, that enemy unit is your Prey:
• When a friendly BEAST SNAGGA unit declares a charge, if your Prey is within 12" of that unit, you can use this part of this ability. If you do: that BEAST SNAGGA unit can re-roll that charge roll; and that BEAST SNAGGA unit must end that charge move engaged with your Prey.
• Each time a BEAST SNAGGA model from your army makes an attack that targets your Prey, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

kult-of-speed.name: Kult of Speed
kult-of-speed._grants_note: Unlike Da Hunt Is On, this rule is unconditional for every SPEED FREEKS unit, so it is a real `grants` entry and shows as a dashed badge on matching unit cards. The ability it points at lives in data/abilities.json.
kult-of-speed.ruleDescription: Adrenaline Junkies: SPEED FREEKS units from your army are eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which they Advanced or Fell Back.

dread-mob.name: Dread Mob
dread-mob._grants_note: Try Dat Button! is rolled fresh each time a unit is selected to shoot or fight, so nothing is granted unconditionally and there are no `grants` here. Same reasoning as Da Big Hunt. The Button Effect table is printed for the player to roll against and read — the app deliberately does not roll it, track it, or apply it.
dread-mob._keywords_note: The BATTLELINE grant is now wired via grantsKeywords, the mechanism added for Rollin' Deff's WAGON. Nothing in the app reads Battleline yet, so it shows on the card and feeds nothing else.
dread-mob.ruleDescription:
Try Dat Button!: Each time a MEK, ORKS WALKER or GROTS VEHICLE unit from your army is selected to shoot or fight, roll one D6. Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in that unit have the corresponding ability shown in the table below.

D6 — BUTTON EFFECT
• 1-2 — [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.
• 3-4 — [LETHAL HITS] ability.
• 5-6 — Each time an attack is made with this weapon, on a Critical Wound, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 2.

Alternatively, when such a unit is selected to shoot or fight, you can select one of the abilities above instead of rolling the D6. If you do, until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [HAZARDOUS] ability as well.

If a weapon equipped by a model from your army has the [HAZARDOUS] ability from multiple sources, each time you take a Hazardous test for that weapon, it is failed on a roll of 1-3.

KEYWORDS: GRETCHIN units from your army gain the BATTLELINE keyword.

green-tide.name: Green Tide
green-tide._grants_note: Mob Mentality is conditional on UNIT SIZE, not on a keyword, so it cannot be expressed as a `grants` entry — those match keywords only. The app does track models per instance, so a size-aware invulnerable save is buildable; it is not built, because no matched-play BOYZ datasheet exists yet and nothing has asked for it. Rule text only for now.
green-tide._size_note: Several Enhancements and Stratagems in this detachment also key off 'contains 10 or more models', and two of them (Raucous Warcaller, Braggin' Rights) let a unit COUNT as 10+ without being 10+. Any future size-aware display has to honour those overrides, not just read inst.models.
green-tide.ruleDescription: Mob Mentality: Each time an attack targets a BOYZ unit from your army, models in that unit have a 6+ invulnerable save against that attack. Each time an attack targets a BOYZ unit from your army that contains 10 or more models, models in that unit have a 5+ invulnerable save against that attack.

bully-boyz.name: Bully Boyz
bully-boyz._grants_note: This rule changes how many times the Waaagh! can be called, and scopes the second one to WARBOSS, NOBZ and MEGANOBZ. It is not a keyword grant. The app's Waaagh! button (FACTION_CALL_ID / FACTION_CALL_TABS in index.html) is Combat Patrol only and tracks no per-battle count, so nothing here is wired to it — rule text only.
bully-boyz.ruleDescription: Da Boss Is Watchin’: At the start of your Command phase, in a turn in which you have not called a Waaagh!, if you have one or more WARBOSS models on the battlefield (or embarked within a TRANSPORT that is on the battlefield), you can call a Waaagh! for a second time this battle. When doing so, that second Waaagh! only counts as having been called for WARBOSS, NOBZ and MEGANOBZ units from your army.

freebooter-krew.name: Freebooter Krew
freebooter-krew._grants_note: Here Be Loot is the second nominated-target rule after Da Big Hunt's Prey: you pick a loot objective each Command phase, and [SUSTAINED HITS 1] only applies within range of it. Both the nomination and the range check are board state, so there is no static grant and no badge. Rule text only.
freebooter-krew.ruleDescription:
Here Be Loot: At the start of your Command phase, select one objective marker. Until the start of your next Command phase, that objective marker is your loot objective.

Each time a model in an ORKS INFANTRY, ORKS MOUNTED or ORKS WALKER unit from your army makes an attack, that attack has the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability if either or both of the following are true:
• That model’s unit is within range of your loot objective.
• That attack targets a unit within range of your loot objective.

speedwaaagh.name: Speedwaaagh!
speedwaaagh._grants_note: Turbo Boostas is an option a unit takes when it Advances, not something it always has, so there is no grant and no badge.
speedwaaagh.ruleDescription:
Turbo Boostas: Each time a SPEED FREEKS or TRUKK unit (excluding AIRCRAFT) from your army Advances, it can use its turbo. If it does, do not make an Advance roll for it; instead, until the end of the phase, models in that unit have a Move characteristic of 24" but can only move in one straight line, and until the end of the turn, ranged weapons equipped by those models have the [ASSAULT] ability and that unit cannot declare a charge.

Designer’s Note: When a unit uses its turbo, the models in that unit cannot pivot, and they cannot make a move of two or more straight lines (e.g. to navigate around obstacles). That unit also cannot declare a charge, even if another rule would let it declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

blitz-brigade.name: Blitz Brigade
blitz-brigade._unique_note: Tagged UNIQUE: WAGONS in the source, immediately above the detachment name. Rollin' Deff carries the same tag and states the exclusivity in its own rule text, so the two cannot be taken together.
blitz-brigade._grants_note: Eager for the Fight triggers on disembarking, which is board state, so there is no grant.
blitz-brigade.ruleDescription: Eager for the Fight: Each time an ORKS unit from your army disembarks from a TRANSPORT, until the end of the turn, you can re-roll Advance and Charge rolls made for that ORKS unit.

more-dakka.name: More Dakka!
more-dakka._rule_note: This rule is named 'Dakka! Dakka! Dakka!', the same name as the Dread Mob STRATAGEM in data/stratagems.json. Different content in different files; the ids differ and they never collide. Do not merge them.
more-dakka._grants_note: The [ASSAULT] half is unconditional for ORKS INFANTRY, so it IS a grant and shows as a badge. The [SUSTAINED HITS 1] half is conditional on the Waaagh! being active, which the app does not track outside Combat Patrol, so only the first half is wired.
more-dakka.ruleDescription:
Dakka! Dakka! Dakka!:
• Friendly ORKS INFANTRY units’ ranged attacks have [ASSAULT].
• In your Shooting phase, if the Waaagh! is active for your army, friendly ORKS INFANTRY units’ ranged attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

rollin-deff.name: Rollin’ Deff
rollin-deff._grants_note: The WAGON keyword grant is real and wired: both of this detachment's Upgrades are 'WAGON unit only', so without it they would match nothing. The re-roll and Advance clauses are dice effects, not grants.
rollin-deff.ruleDescription:
Thundering Wagons:
• Friendly BATTLEWAGON / HUNTA RIG / KILL RIG units have WAGON.
• Friendly WAGON units can re-roll Charge rolls.
• When a friendly WAGON unit is selected to make an Advance move, that unit can change Advance rolls to a 6.

This detachment has the WAGONS tag and cannot be taken with another WAGONS detachment.

taktikal-brigade.name: Taktikal Brigade
taktikal-brigade._grants_note: The BATTLELINE grant is wired for display only — nothing in the app reads Battleline yet, but the mechanism now exists for Rollin' Deff's WAGON, so this costs nothing and keeps the rule honest on the card.
taktikal-brigade.ruleDescription:
Lissen ’Ere:
• Friendly STORMBOYZ units have BATTLELINE.
• When a friendly BOYZ / KOMMANDOS / STORMBOYZ unit is selected to make an Advance or Fall Back move, that move does not prevent that unit from being eligible to start an Action.

equatorial-hordes.name: Equatorial Hordes
equatorial-hordes._grants_note: Scouts 6" goes to up to three units you pick in Declare Battle Formations, not to every matching unit, so it cannot be a blanket grant.
equatorial-hordes.ruleDescription: Jungle Know-Wotz: In the Declare Battle Formations step, select up to three friendly MOB / KOMMANDOS units. Those units have the Scouts 6" ability until the end of the battle.
